name: Stocks
overview: The Scriptures depict stocks as a form of physical restraint used primarily as punishment, often within prison settings. Job describes his feet being placed in stocks as a metaphor for suffering and close scrutiny by God (Job 13:27; 33:11), while Proverbs likens foolish correction to the sudden imposition of stocks (Proverbs 7:22). Jeremiah’s experience shows stocks being used to imprison and discipline prophets near the house of the LORD (Jeremiah 20:2), and Acts records the apostles’ feet fastened in stocks during imprisonment (Acts 16:24). Together, these passages illustrate how stocks symbolize both literal confinement and the consequences of disobedience under divine authority.
